reverse-list.quickAnswer: Reverses the order of lines in any list instantly: the last line becomes the first and the first becomes the last. Paste one item per line and get the flipped list back, with one-click copy and .txt download. Handy for reading logs backwards, flipping countdown lists or turning newest-first exports into chronological order.
